verdict.line: You lose if you trade autos into his banked Indestructible shield or get caught alone after level 6 Realm of Death; you win if you poke with Mourning Mist and wall him off the instant he commits Death's Grasp.

brief.thesis: Mordekaiser's W (Indestructible) banks every point of damage dealt and taken into a shield he can pop as a heal, so straight trading just feeds him sustain. His only way to force a fight is E (Death's Grasp) pulling you in range — and that pull is also the exact moment your W (Dark Procession) wall can seal him in with you or seal him away from you, which is why OP.GG's own tip is built entirely around that one interaction.

theirWindow.when: when his Death's Grasp E is up
theirWindow.what: He can yank you into melee range for a Q (Obliterate) and auto chain while his W shield soaks the return damage. Don't stand in E range at the wave if you're not ready to answer the pull with your wall.

yourWindow.when: when his E is on cooldown
yourWindow.what: He has no way to force range on you. Walk up and land Q (Last Rites) and E (Mourning Mist) for free poke, since he has to either tank it or back off.

start.why: 60.9% win rate over 46 games — the magic resist and sustain matter directly against Mordekaiser's magic-damage poke and all-in attempts.

boots.why: 51.6% win rate over 62 games; the flat magic resist cuts the burst from his Q/E combo when he commits the pull.

core.why: Shared first item across every listed build path — the on-hit damage and move speed let you punish the window right after his E/W are both down.
Armor shred on autos cuts into the resistances he stacks, and the CDR loops your Q/E faster in the short trades this lane rewards.

runes.keystoneWhy: 54.2% win rate at 19.7% pick — the sustain and periodic max-health proc suit the repeated short trades this lane rewards rather than one all-in commitment. Master-tier Yorick players instead run Conqueror (Precision) across 488 games; that fits you better if you're confident trading autos through his W shield for the stacking damage and heal instead of the flat Grasp proc.

summoners.why: Flash + Teleport is the standard pick (52.2% win rate, 54.9% pick) and fits Yorick's global wall/split-push threat. Flash + Ignite posts a higher 66.7% win rate if you want to punish his all-in directly — he has no displacement besides the E pull, so a secured kill after you wall him in is realistic.

playing.title: Save W for his E pull
playing.detail: The instant he lands Death's Grasp, drop Dark Procession to either wall him away from you or trap him inside with you per OP.GG's own line — before his Darkness Rise third stack goes off.

playing.title: Poke, don't full trade
playing.detail: Indestructible banks damage from both sides, so standing and trading autos heals him back. Hit Q (Last Rites) and E (Mourning Mist) and disengage instead of chaining full exchanges.

playing.title: Track his passive stack count
playing.detail: Darkness Rise triggers after 3 landed hits and gives him a damage aura plus move speed — back out of range before that third hit connects.

playing.title: Trap low-health dives with W
playing.detail: When he commits at low HP, wall him in since Indestructible only shields and doesn't reposition him — he has no way out once Dark Procession seals the space.

playing.title: Respect R once it's up
playing.detail: From level 6 he can isolate you for a 1v1 duel with Realm of Death. Don't overextend alone without a grave or wave advantage once his ultimate is off cooldown.

playing.title: Itemize into his shield
playing.detail: Black Cleaver's shred and Serpent's Fang if the game runs long both cut directly against the sustain his W is designed to generate.

brief.patchCaveat: Build paths, runes, summoners and the win-rate figures above are measured from live games on the current patch (OP.GG); the mechanical reasoning and trade timing are my own read of the kits, not measured data.

stats.opponentTip: If pulled by his (E), use [W] to trap him inside to retreat before his (P) activates. Use [E] to poke and [W] to trap him inside when he is running low on health to kill him.
